test_title: PYST 67: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A + B' means 'B is the father of A'

'A @ B' means 'B is the brother of A'

'A $ B' means 'B is the husband of A'

'A & B' means 'B is the wife of A'

If A @ B + C & D @ E, then how is E related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 @
 $
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Brother
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: A @ B + C & D @ E

It means: B is the Brother of A, C is the Father of B, D is the Wife of C, E is the Brother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58e1bb225fd004c38fdd3f3f1b38ec08b9a3afc67c5ee174137241f91bc99452.png] 

Here, E is the 'Mother's brother' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
